release_gate: The single prechosen mean_release candidate must have lower equal12 cost than old radio_mean and both release-aware external controls, with paired traffic-seed t95 upper bounds below zero. Its primary mean must not exceed radio_mean, and its 10kHz cost difference versus mean must have a below-zero t95 interval. Report every arm/condition. Failure does not promote a different arm or change parameters. A pass only permits fresh task confirmation; it is not publication readiness.
scope: 20 paired traffic seeds, 12 original conditions, fixed 225 task bank; intervals do not establish independent-task generalization.
adapter: RouteLLM-score is a constructed calibration-only 1D KNN quality adapter, not native RouteLLM. Original prediction times plus separately recorded per-query adapter time are charged.
static_ablation: Static removes w*(1+kappa*mu) but retains kappa*v/2; Intrinsic removes both. Static degradation is not used as the main gain.
concurrency_probe: 36 cells, four requests each, 12 reused calibration tasks, two providers, widths 1/2/4 and two repeats. Single-attempt cap4096. Separate endpoint diagnostic, not policy validation or a replacement response bank. CSV includes explicitly labeled descriptive independent-replica counterfactuals; those are not measurements.
